metadata.description: Khevin's personal Claude Code marketplace — a growing toolbox of design and product plugins.

plugins.name: design-expert
plugins.description: One command that triages design work (plan, build, iterate, review, write), discovers the project's design system, picks the output surface (Figma, Claude Design canvas, or code), and ships with craft and evidence: NNg heuristics, Universal Design 7, anti-AI-slop patterns, and an eighteen-designer pantheon convened as a council.
